package frontend

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"github.com/gogo/protobuf/jsonpb"
	"github.com/gogo/protobuf/proto"
	"github.com/grafana/dskit/user"
	"github.com/grafana/tempo/pkg/tempopb"
	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
	"io"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"net/url"
	"os"
	"sort"
	"testing"
)

func TestPulseDefaultNameHandlers(t *testing.T) {
	raw, err := os.ReadFile("/tmp/pulse-tempo-default-names/oracle.json")
	require.NoError(t, err)
	var cases []struct {
		Query    string          `json:"query"`
		Complete json.RawMessage `json:"complete"`
		V1       json.RawMessage `json:"v1"`
	}
	require.NoError(t, json.Unmarshal(raw, &cases))
	for _, c := range cases {
		for _, version := range []int{1, 2} {
			for _, scope := range []string{"", "&scope=", "&scope=none"} {
				v2 := &tempopb.SearchTagsV2Response{}
				require.NoError(t, json.Unmarshal(c.Complete, v2))
				stored := &tempopb.SearchTagsV2Response{}
				for _, s := range v2.Scopes {
					if s.Name != "intrinsic" {
						stored.Scopes = append(stored.Scopes, s)
					}
				}
				v1 := &tempopb.SearchTagsResponse{}
				require.NoError(t, json.Unmarshal(c.V1, v1))
				next := &mockRoundTripper{responseFn: func() proto.Message {
					if version == 1 {
						return v1
					}
					return stored
				}}
				f := frontendWithSettings(t, next, nil, nil, nil)
				path := "/api/search/tags?q=" + url.QueryEscape(c.Query) + scope
				if version == 2 {
					path = "/api/v2/search/tags?q=" + url.QueryEscape(c.Query) + scope
				}
				req := httptest.NewRequest("GET", path, nil)
				req = req.WithContext(user.InjectOrgID(context.Background(), "tenant"))
				rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
				if version == 1 {
					f.SearchTagsHandler.ServeHTTP(rec, req)
				} else {
					f.SearchTagsV2Handler.ServeHTTP(rec, req)
				}
				require.Equal(t, http.StatusOK, rec.Code)
				wire, err := io.ReadAll(rec.Body)
				require.NoError(t, err)
				if version == 1 {
					got := &tempopb.SearchTagsResponse{}
					require.NoError(t, jsonpb.Unmarshal(bytes.NewReader(wire), got))
					sort.Strings(got.TagNames)
					require.Equal(t, v1.TagNames, got.TagNames)
				} else {
					got := &tempopb.SearchTagsV2Response{}
					require.NoError(t, jsonpb.Unmarshal(bytes.NewReader(wire), got))
					sort.Slice(got.Scopes, func(i, j int) bool { return got.Scopes[i].Name < got.Scopes[j].Name })
					for _, s := range got.Scopes {
						sort.Strings(s.Tags)
					}
					got.Metrics = nil
					require.True(t, proto.Equal(got, v2), "got=%s want=%s", got.String(), v2.String())
				}
			}
		}
	}
	// Actual frontend requests, but owned fake backend responses. Not a live datasource.
	require.NoError(t, os.WriteFile("/tmp/pulse-tempo-default-names/frontend-oracle.json", []byte("{\"cases\":90,\"omitted_empty_none_scopes\":true,\"v1_excludes_intrinsics\":true,\"v2_adds_intrinsics\":true,\"backend\":\"owned_stub\"}\n"), 0644))
}
